_about: The same sabotage the other way round: the queue anchored this task to NZTEST-4500X-16SFP+ and the page is about the plain NZTEST-4500X-16SFP. A resolver that folds '+' writes the plain card's switching capacity onto the '+' card. Both directions are here because a fold is symmetric and a one-way test would pass a one-way fix. It is a meraki page rather than a second provantage one so this directory's report tag stays the fixture-only 'provantage+meraki' and can never overwrite a real runs/reports file.
